name: Aborting an Action
summary: Change a declared action to a defensive action, usually by spending Willpower or succeeding on a Willpower roll.

name: Ambush
summary: Attack from concealment or surprise. The target must notice the attacker in time to defend normally.

name: Blind Fighting / Blind Fire
summary: Attempt close or ranged attacks without normal vision, with increased difficulty.

name: Flank or Rear Attack
summary: Attack from a position the defender cannot easily cover, reducing or preventing normal defense.

name: Movement
summary: Walk, run, or sprint during combat. Faster movement may modify attacks and defenses.

name: Multiple Actions
summary: Divide a dice pool or use another permitted method to perform more than one action in a turn.

name: Targeting
summary: Aim for a specific body part or object. Smaller targets increase difficulty but may provide extra effect or damage.

name: Block
summary: Use Dexterity + Brawl or Martial Arts to stop a close-combat attack with the body.

name: Dodge
summary: Use Dexterity + Athletics to evade an attack by moving away, dropping, or reaching cover.

name: Parry
summary: Use Dexterity + Melee or Martial Arts and a weapon or shield to deflect a close-combat attack.

name: Desperate Defense
summary: Devote the turn to repeated defensive actions with reduced multiple-action penalties.

name: Clinch
summary: Grapple and damage an opponent with Strength + Brawl. Either character may later damage or attempt escape.

name: Close Distance
summary: Move inside the reach of a longer weapon. Weapon-length differences can penalize the shorter-armed fighter until distance is closed.

name: Disarm
summary: Strike or seize an opponent's weapon to knock it from their hand without directly damaging them.

name: Hold
summary: Restrain an opponent without inflicting damage. The victim may attempt to escape on a later action.

name: Jab Pistol
summary: Press or jab a pistol into a nearby target before firing, increasing damage but risking disarm.

name: Kick
summary: A harder unarmed attack that generally inflicts Strength +1 bashing damage.

name: Multiple Opponents
summary: Fighting several attackers increases the difficulty of attacks and defenses.

name: Strike / Punch
summary: A normal unarmed attack using Dexterity + Brawl and Strength-based bashing damage.

name: Sweep
summary: Use a leg or weapon to damage and knock an opponent down.

name: Tackle
summary: Rush and slam into a target, causing damage and risking knockdown for both combatants.

name: Weapon Strike
summary: A normal close-combat weapon attack using Dexterity + Melee and the weapon's damage.

name: Aiming
summary: Spend one or more turns lining up a shot to gain additional attack dice, subject to weapon and target limits.

name: Automatic Fire
summary: Empty a large portion of a weapon's ammunition to gain many attack dice at increased difficulty.

name: Cover
summary: Use terrain or objects to become harder to hit, sometimes at the cost of making your own attacks harder.

name: Multiple Shots
summary: Fire more than once by using the multiple-action rules, limited by the weapon's rate.

name: Range
summary: Point-blank shots are easier; attacks beyond normal range are harder; attacks beyond maximum range fail.

name: Reloading
summary: Replace or refill ammunition. Reloading normally requires an action.

name: Strafing
summary: Spray automatic fire across an area or several nearby targets, dividing successes among them.

name: Short Burst
summary: Fire a short burst to gain attack dice at increased difficulty without emptying the entire weapon.

name: Two Weapons
summary: Attack with a weapon in each hand. Off-hand and multiple-action penalties normally apply.
